name: tuned_phasor
summary: Q32 phase accumulator with octave/semi/cent tuning. `inc` (note-derived) = note increment × 2^(octave + semi/12 + cent/1200); `octave` (−3..3), `semi` (−11..11), `cent` (−100..100). `pitch` (control, Q15) scales it ±1 octave; `fm` (audio, Q15) scaled by 2^16 = ±π phase (the FM index); `mod` (control) is a small additive offset.
